data.name: OpportunityActions_DisplayName
data.comment: Control name in the form maker's component picker.

data.name: OpportunityActions_Description
data.value: Active recommendations for the current Opportunity, with reasons and action controls.
data.comment: Component description for form makers.

data.name: OpportunityActions_AnchorField
data.comment: Maker-facing label for the text column the control is attached to on the form.

data.name: OpportunityActions_AnchorFieldDescription
data.value: Attach the control to any single-line text column on the Opportunity form. The value is only an anchor; the control reads the current Opportunity automatically.
data.comment: Maker instruction explaining the anchor column has no functional value.

data.name: OpportunityActions_EntityId
data.comment: Maker-facing label for the current record's unique-identifier input.

data.name: OpportunityActions_EntityIdDescription
data.value: Bind to the current Opportunity record identifier.
data.comment: Maker instruction for the record-identifier input.

data.name: OpportunityActions_EntityName
data.comment: Maker-facing label for the logical table-name input.

data.name: OpportunityActions_EntityNameDescription
data.value: Configure the logical table name as opportunity.
data.comment: Maker instruction; the lowercase logical name opportunity is a literal configuration value.

data.name: OpportunityActions_Title
data.comment: Seller-facing list heading and accessible section name.

data.name: OpportunityActions_Refresh
data.comment: Accessible name and tooltip for the icon-only button that reloads the current record's recommendations.

data.name: OpportunityActions_List
data.comment: Accessible name for the keyboard-focusable scrolling recommendation list.

data.name: OpportunityActions_Loading
data.comment: Seller-facing live status while a page request is pending.

data.name: OpportunityActions_Empty
data.value: No active recommendations are available for this Opportunity.
data.comment: Successful empty result after no continuation remains; not an access-error message.

data.name: OpportunityActions_Error
data.value: Recommendations could not be loaded. Check access or try again.
data.comment: Generic seller-facing initial-load failure; never include raw service errors.

data.name: OpportunityActions_PartialError
data.value: Some recommendations are shown, but more could not be loaded. Refresh to try again.
data.comment: Automatic paging failure with previous rows retained; Refresh names the icon-only retry action.

data.name: OpportunityActions_SaveFirst
data.value: Save the Opportunity and verify the record-ID binding before loading recommendations.
data.comment: Missing or invalid current-record binding, including an unsaved form.

data.name: OpportunityActions_WrongEntity
data.value: Configure this control on an Opportunity form with entity name opportunity.
data.comment: Configuration error; the final lowercase opportunity is a literal logical table name.

data.name: OpportunityActions_LoadedCount
data.comment: Seller-facing live status; {0} is the number of loaded rows, not a verified total.

data.name: OpportunityActions_Unavailable
data.comment: Fallback row heading when stored display data cannot be safely interpreted.

data.name: OpportunityActions_Active
data.comment: Recommendation UI-status badge, not a command.

data.name: OpportunityActions_Done
data.comment: Badge for a recommendation marked as done, not a command.

data.name: OpportunityActions_Dismissed
data.comment: Badge for a dismissed recommendation, not a command.

data.name: OpportunityActions_Inactive
data.comment: Badge for an inactive Dataverse PAC row.

data.name: OpportunityActions_Removed
data.comment: Badge for an inactive PAC row with the Removed status reason; the row still exists.

data.name: OpportunityActions_UnknownStatus
data.comment: Badge when the stored recommendation UI status is missing or unknown.

data.name: OpportunityActions_Score
data.comment: Read-only row metadata; {0} is a localized numeric score.

data.name: OpportunityActions_MarkDone
data.comment: Marks this recommendation complete using the lifecycle API.

data.name: OpportunityActions_Dismiss
data.comment: Dismisses a recommendation as not relevant.

data.name: OpportunityActions_OpenAction
data.comment: Accessible card action name; {0} is the recommendation title.

data.name: OpportunityActions_Updating
data.comment: Live status while an action operation is pending.

data.name: OpportunityActions_ActionError
data.value: The action could not be completed. Check access and try again, or refresh the list.
data.comment: Generic operation failure; no raw service details.

data.name: OpportunityActions_WhyRecommended
data.comment: Heading for the stored scoring explanation and impact.

data.name: OpportunityActions_ReasonUnavailable
data.value: A recommendation reason is not available.
data.comment: Shown when score details have no safe text explanation.

data.name: OpportunityActions_ShowMore
data.comment: Expands this card's full text and distinct details; does not show a score or load another page.

data.name: OpportunityActions_ShowLess
data.comment: Collapses this recommendation back to its short summary.
